experiment_name: No Skill vs. Text Domain Expert Skill (v4)
hypothesis: Equipping agents with flutter-text-domain-expert (v4 with Edge-Scrolling, Selection Invariants & Static Text Pipeline) provides deep architectural understanding of _ScrollableSelectionContainerDelegate and EdgeDraggingAutoScroller interaction in nested scrollables and multi-axis viewport selections, guiding agents to accurately diagnose coordinate space transformations, handle drag targets that exceed scrollable boundaries without tripping assertion failures, and place focused regression tests in scrollable_selection_test.dart while adhering to layer boundary invariants.
title: [two_dimensional_scrollables] Error occurred while selecting text within a CustomScrollView that contains a TableView.

treatment.description: Commit 7c45588fc9 (skill v4 with Producer Invariants vs Consumer Band-Aids rule)

task_prompt_template:
FIRST STEP:
git checkout --quiet {commit}

TASK:
1. Inspect the issue using `gh issue view 181169 --repo flutter/flutter` (do not pass `--comments`).
2. Reproduce and identify the root cause in the Flutter framework.
3. Write a regression test in the appropriate test suite under packages/flutter/test/. Verify the exact failure signature: Did the test fail on the expected expect() assertion or bug-specific exception, or did it fail with an unrelated TestFailure / compilation error? Make sure it fails because of the former.
4. Implement the fix in packages/flutter/lib/src/.
5. Ensure `dart analyze --fatal-infos` and `dart format` pass on all modified files.
6. Verify the regression test passes now that the fix has been implemented.
expected_failure_signature: Failed assertion in EdgeDraggingAutoScroller._scroll ('Drag target size is larger than scrollable size, which may cause bouncing') or unhandled AssertionError during selection edge update in nested scrollables prior to framework fix
